description: This header defines template classes and functions for custom formatting, including deferred formatting, optional value formatting, and prefixing optional values, used within the ocudu support formatting namespace.

classes.name: custom_formattable
classes.description: A template class that holds a formatting functor for deferred formatting.

classes.name: value_or_else
classes.description: A template struct for formatting an optional value or an alternative string.

classes.name: optional_prefix_formatter
classes.description: A template struct that prefixes an optional value if it is set.

methods.name: make_formattable
methods.description: Creates a custom_formattable object with a deferred format function.

methods.name: format_value_or
methods.description: Creates a value_or_else object to format an optional value or an alternative string.

methods.name: format_unit_or
methods.description: Creates a value_or_else object with a unit string and an alternative string.

methods.name: add_prefix_if_set
methods.description: Creates an optional_prefix_formatter to prefix an optional value if it is set.
